How to play

Rules

  • Each side has a 10×10 board and five ships.
  • The fleet is Carrier (5), Battleship (4), Cruiser (3), Submarine (3), and Patrol Boat (2).
  • Ships may not overlap or extend outside the board.
  • Players alternate turns. A miss, hit, or sunk ship passes the turn.
  • Repeated or invalid shots are rejected and do not use a turn.
  • The first fleet to lose all five ships loses the game.

Controls

  • Mouse: click a cell to place a ship or fire.
  • Touch: tap a cell or a ship card.
  • Drag: drag a ship card onto the placement board.
  • Keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, R rotates, and Enter or Space activates the focused cell.

Difficulty

  • Easy chooses uniformly at random among untried cells.
  • Medium hunts randomly, then targets cells adjacent to unresolved hits and extends along aligned hits.
  • Hard enumerates legal placements for the remaining fleet, weights those covering unresolved hits, and fires at the highest-scoring untried cell.

Every difficulty places its ships automatically. The AI never sees your hidden ship positions.

Multiplayer

  1. Open Host and wait for a room code.
  2. Share the join link or read the six-character code to your opponent.
  3. Your opponent opens Join, enters the code, and connects.
  4. Place your fleets, press Ready, and the host fires first.
  5. Use the chat box at any time; chatting never changes whose turn it is.

Your unhit ship positions stay in your browser and are never sent to the server or your opponent.
